programme.desc: S04 E03 — Desert Mysteries Investigate an abandoned village in the shifting sands on Dubai's outskirts and a collection of inexplicable stone circles in Colombia; a mysterious hilltop tower in Iran and a puzzling purple phenomenon in Chile's Atacama Desert.
programme.title: Mysteries From Above

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Northern Lights/Faded Giant Cousins Billy and John Smith encounter a massive ship triple the size of a football stadium; guards at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana spot an unidentified object overhead.
programme.title: Close Encounters

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Fire in the Sky/Arizona Objects Several dozen witnesses in Pennsylvania reported seeing a fiery object fall through the sky and land in nearby woods; hundreds of people stargazing in Phoenix, Arizona witness strange lights flying in a V-formation.
programme.title: Close Encounters

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Mummies Rethink what it's known about death and preservation; see why Denmark's perfectly preserved Tollund Man raises questions, observe Portuguese bodies that rewrite history, and uncover the mystery of Scotland's Frankenstein mummies.
programme.title: Buried Evidence

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Basement Dweller, Do Not Resuscitate and Children of the Barn A dark entity attacks a security guard in the basement of a nursing home; an EMT has a chilling encounter with a dying man; a paramedic hears ghostly children playing in an old barn.
programme.title: Paranormal 911

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Ghost Soldiers Stories of soldiers' spirits who come back to visit the living.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S02 E20 — UFO Eruption and Alien Spheres The truth behind a pattern of UFO sightings near volcanoes; the origin of the strange stone spheres of Costa Rica; the secret of an unidentified man living alone in the jungle.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: S02 E21 — Mysterious Sky Moans and Dragon Sighting A UFO spotted by multiple residents of a Florida town; the cause of a ghoulish moaning sound from the sky; a dragon could have been responsible for a bizarre incident in China.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: S02 E12 — The Ghost of Al Capone and More Contact with an infamous gangster; a flying witch terrifies onlookers; a poltergeist torments a college student; and something is alive in the sewers.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S02 E03 — Dark Entities Discovering evil beings that hide in the shadows, waiting for a chance to pounce; seeing why a Pennsylvania well is a gateway to terror; crossing paths with an otherworldly stalker in Georgia; exorcize a dark spirit in a South Carolina family home.
programme.title: My Haunted Hometown

programme.desc: S02 E05 — Sleep Demons Private investigator Jennifer Marshall and paranormal investigator Ali Houmani investigate whether dreams can kill.
programme.title: Mysteries Decoded

programme.desc: S08 E06 — A Mother's Nightmare Kelly and Tonya look into the murder of a hard-working mother who was stabbed and bludgeoned to death; the investigation uncovers a secret affair and a revelation as shocking as the murder itself.
programme.title: Cold Justice

programme.desc: Rendlesham Forest Incident Visit Britain's version of Roswell, New Mexico, where a series of reported sightings have been linked with alleged UFO landings. Hear from a US Air Force base commander who describes what he.
programme.title: UFO Chronicles

programme.desc: S02 E07 — Two-Headed Serpent & Mummified Monster A petrified creature discovered in Russia is said to be the work of the mythical Baba Yaga; a possible genetic experiment gone wrong; a fire with a mind of its own.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.title: House Hunters International

programme.title: House Hunters International

programme.title: House Hunters International

programme.title: House Hunters International

programme.title: House Hunters International

programme.title: Home Town

programme.desc: S10 E11 — Built Like a Bunker Over 13 years, a couple has have moved countless times, living separately and out of suitcases through medical school and residency; now, with two kids and life more settled, they turn to Ben and Erin to find their first permanent family home.
programme.title: Home Town

programme.desc: S05 E01 — Fixing a Cheap Flip With her daughter's dire health crisis alleviated, a mother is ready to part with a 1920s bungalow she bought to be by her side. She's looking to get top dollar, so she's calling on Lyndsay and Leslie go bold with an era-specific, glitzy upgrade.
programme.title: Unsellable Houses

programme.desc: S05 E06 — Sell With a Kiss After helping friends settle into a new and larger family home, Lyndsay and Leslie take on their former place; the twins roll up their sleeves and look to make some updates in hopes of getting the most out of their old, well-lived-in townhouse.
programme.title: Unsellable Houses

programme.desc: S05 E04 — Selling a Well-Loved Home Lyndsay and Leslie take over the reins to help a father part ways with his family home; it's a century-old house with features from multiple eras, so the twins look to make a cohesive and modern update in order to get top dollar.
programme.title: Unsellable Houses

programme.desc: S05 E07 — A Doctor's Oasis Lyndsay and Leslie help a busy doctor increase the equity on her newly purchased condo and transform it into a serene oasis.
programme.title: Unsellable Houses

programme.title: Home Town

programme.desc: S10 E15 — Ben vs. Bats After countless setbacks, an engaged couple's finally saved enough to renovate their first home together; the house needs more work than expected, and with bats in the attic and a tight budget, they call on Ben and Erin for help.
programme.title: Home Town

programme.desc: S10 E10 — Steel Magnolia After finishing a 10-month reno on their forever home, a couple enlist Ben and Erin to help finish their backyard; they want to include a pool for their son, but they drop a late twist that could change everything.
